name: @hn/vscode
description: Haven Harness in VS Code: ask the agent, see each change as a diff, and approve it once at a time.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Haven Harness reads instruction files, skills and hooks from the folder, which are text from whoever wrote the folder. It does nothing until you trust the folder.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Haven Harness works on a real folder on this computer.

hn.path.markdownDescription: The `hn` command to start. Only your own user settings can set it: a folder's `.vscode/settings.json` cannot choose what program runs.

hn.model.markdownDescription: The model to ask for (`--model`). Empty uses hn's own default. Only your own user settings can set it.

hn.baseUrl.markdownDescription: A model server to use instead of the default (`--base-url`), for example a local Ollama. Only your own user settings can set it, because it decides where your code and prompts are sent.
